text: Councillor Shelley Carroll has resigned from the Toronto Police Services Board, effective March 26, 2018. This Motion is urgent as City Council should immediately appoint a replacement to the Board to ensure the Board can continue to govern effectively and avoid issues associated with quorum.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. Notwithstanding the requirement to canvas Members on the vacancy, City Council appoint Councillor Jim Hart to the Toronto Police Services Board for a term of office ending November 30, 2018 and until a successor is appointed.
